## 2026 assessment

[Read the assessment online](2026/assessment.html){.btn .btn-primary}
[Download the assessment PDF](2026/assessment.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

**Version: November 8, 2026 · Review draft**

The HTML and PDF present the same assessment revision. The HTML provides
interactive figures and navigation; the PDF provides a paginated copy for
reading and printing. This review draft presents Model 26.0 as the working
assessment; final scientific adoption and harvest advice follow the assessment
review process.

The report includes the current Appendix H introduction and portrait layouts
for narrower PDF tables. Supporting references available only in the authors’
local working files appear as text rather than download links. Manual
accessibility review remains pending.
